Open your eyes, people. Look at what is really happening behind the scenes with this so-called "Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU)" and their neatly timed one-month ultimatum directed at the federal government. They want us to believe this is just a routine labor dispute over the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, culminating in resolutions from their 54th National Executive Council. That is the exact fairy tale the establishment wants you to swallow. 

This isn't about unresolved negotiations at all. It is a calculated, synchronized pressure campaign orchestrated by unseen hands within the elite structure to destabilize the system on cue. By publicly threatening an indefinite nationwide strike if demands are unmet, they are executing a pre-planned script designed to manufacture crisis and distract the public from the real agenda being pushed behind closed doors. Every deadline and every official meeting is just theatre to keep the population managed and compliant. Do not fall for the official narrative.
